name: Hemei IV
description: Hemei IV was a wealthy Core Worlds planet that was the origin point of the Cosmic Balance religion. The Bakur Mining Corporation also originated there, and its Cosmic Balance–practicing executive officers believed that the world's affluence was disruptive. To remedy that state, the Corporation eventually led the settlement of the Wild Space planet Bakura. By more than a century later, the Cosmic Balance had ceased to be practiced on Hemei IV.
